verdicts.reason: A and B look the same: the original 614-wide layout is dropped into the centre of the square canvas without being rearranged. That leaves wide empty side bands, a dead zone of about 100px between the RSVP URL and the tiny, hard-to-read legal text, and the same awkward floating phone. Both also keep the visible 'missing asset' placeholder box at the bottom right. The only difference I can see is that A's SOLSTICE logo is very slightly larger, which doesn't matter.
